name: metal-button
title: Metal Button
blurb: Metallic button with beveled edges and inset glow.
description: A button with layered inset shadows creating a metallic, beveled appearance. Rendered as 'button' or polymorphic 'as' component.
use_when: You need a button that looks tactile and dimensional with a beveled metal finish.
avoid_when: On minimal or flat design systems.
a11y: Standard button semantics. Beveled effect is purely visual; no semantic content.
